query: QA the refunds feature in src/refunds/. docs/refunds.md says a refund is refused after 30 days. Find missing tests and add regression tests.
expected_behavior: Runs node run.mjs start --repo . before any other step and node run.mjs end as the last step
Reads SKILL.md, then requirements.md and code.md, and does not read running-app.md
Records the requirement with source kind spec, ref docs/refunds.md:<line> and a word-for-word quote of the committed text
Runs mutate.mjs with --files on the implementing lines, --tests on the module's unit test files, --runner pointing at paired-agent-tdd's direct-run.mjs, and ZT_RUN_DIR set to the run folder

Judges each surviving mutant as equivalent, unstated or real before filing it, and files the test gap only for a real survivor, with an executed proof whose ref and quote are the mutant's run and ZT-MUTANT ... exit=0 stamp
Adds the regression test as a new case or a new file in the existing unit test folder, never changes or removes an existing test line or product code, and never runs git commit or git push
Proves the new test with a passing direct-run.mjs ledger entry (exit 0) and a killed entry for the same mutant id, from a mutate.mjs run on a snapshot that holds the new test
Runs findings.mjs and gives the user the report.md path and the counts it printed, stating no finding that the report does not list as verified

query: Write regression tests for the discount code in src/pricing/discount.ts.
expected_behavior: Finds no written requirement for combining two discount codes, and asks one numbered batch of questions, each with its reading of the current behavior and the file:line it saw it at
Waits for the answers and does not write a test that pins the current behavior of an unstated case
Saves each answer word for word to <run>/answers.md as an A<n>: block with the time, and cites it as source kind user, ref A<n>
A question left unanswered gets no test, goes in the unconfirmed list of findings.json and appears under Unconfirmed in the report
Treats a code comment or an existing test's assertion as a question for the user, never as a requirement

query: QA the checkout flow against https://shop.example.com.
expected_behavior: Reads running-app.md and launches the project's e2e runner only through node target.mjs run --url https://shop.example.com
target.mjs exits 3 because the host is not local; the agent then asks the user to confirm that exact URL and warns that the tests may write data there
Does not pass --confirm-target before the user says yes in this run, and never confirms the URL on its own
Never uses a browser-automation tool and never sends requests to the URL outside target.mjs
Without a yes, it starts the app locally the way the project documents, or stops and says why; it ends with node run.mjs end

query: Find weak tests in the order totals module. The ticket is https://github.com/acme/shop/issues/42.
expected_behavior: Saves the ticket text word for word to <run>/ticket.md with gh issue view 42 --comments before quoting it, and cites it as source kind ticket with the ticket URL as ref
When a new test that encodes a requirement fails on HEAD with an assertion failure, files a defect with the failing run's ZT-RUN id, its exit code and the assertion message quoted

Keeps the defect test in the suite under a strict expected-failure marker (pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True), test.fails, test.failing or test.fail) with a skip-reason: defect <finding id>: <title> comment on the line before it
Does not fix the product code, and hands the defect to the user or to paired-agent-tdd
A weak test gets a new test that kills its surviving mutant; the weak test itself is left unchanged
Picks the repo inventory scope, not a feature deep-dive, and reads no mode file
Runs python3 pr-test-tiers.py --inventory once and reports each module with no e2e tests, plus the unmapped and untiered lists
Runs no tests, mutants or agents beyond reading that JSON, and ends with node run.mjs end
